request.prompt:
Goods: Office swivel chair with gas-lift height adjustment, upholstered, metal base
Country of origin: CN

Chosen so far: 94 Furniture; bedding, mattresses, mattress supports, cushions and similar stuffed furnishings; lamps and lighting fittings, n.e.c.; illuminated signs, illuminated name-plates and the like; prefabricated buildings

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 9401: Seats (not those of heading no. 9402), whether or not convertible into beds and parts thereof
    contains 940139: Seats; swivel with variable height adjustment of other than wood, excluding medical, surgical, dental, veterinary or barber furniture
    contains 940131: Seats; swivel with variable height adjustment of wood, excluding medical, surgical, dental, veterinary or barber furniture
    contains 940171: Seats; with metal frames, upholstered, (excluding medical, surgical, dental, veterinary or barber furniture)
- 9402: Furniture; medical, surgical, dental or veterinary (e.g. operating tables, hospital beds, dentists' chairs) barbers' chairs; parts
    contains 940210: Chairs; dentists', barbers' or similar chairs having rotating as well as both reclining and elevating movements, and parts thereof
- 9403: Furniture and parts thereof, n.e.c. in chapter 94
    contains 940310: Furniture; metal, for office use

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: An office swivel chair with height adjustment is a seat of heading 9401 (subheading 940139 for swivel seats of non-wood material), not medical/barber furniture of 9402 or other furniture of 9403.
